doc.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

title: How Heard came to the bass: a ninth-grade band class
summary: Asked about Red Holloway's comment, Heard jokes about him and says he became a bassist because the band class needed one.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: And welcome. On our way over to the interview we had a comment from Red Holloway about how he thinks that you held that whole first session together over there today and being that the bass is such as important instrument, we wonder how you came to the bass and what attracted you to that instrument?
Okay. I’ll answer your first thing. Red Holloway — he lies all the time.
Bass? I was in the band class one day, I think it was in ninth grade or something like that, and they needed a bass player. So he said, “You — play the bass.”
That was it. Not very romantic, is it?
